description: Structured eval definitions for the Lambda Function Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across workload types (API backend, Java SnapStart, report generator) and prerequisite failure branches (deprecated runtime, missing NAT Gateway). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Production API backend with VPC + NAT Gateway + KMS + on-failure destination
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — full checklist with VPC, NAT Gateway, KMS, tracing
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a production Lambda function named "order-api-prod" in us-east-1. Runtime: python3.12. Handler: app.handler. It needs to access an RDS PostgreSQL instance in a VPC (subnets: subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb; security group: sg-orders-api). The function also calls Stripe API (needs internet access via NAT Gateway). Use KMS key alias/lambda-env-key for env var encryption. Environment: DB_HOST=orders-db.cluster.example.rds.amazonaws.com. STRIPE_API_KEY referenced via Secrets Manager. Memory: 512 MB, Timeout: 15s. On-failure destination: order-api-dlq (SQS). X-Ray tracing active. CloudWatch retention: 30 days. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FUNCTION: order-api-prod
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Execution IAM role — least-privilege (DynamoDB + S3 + Secrets Manager scoped)
  [✓]      Runtime — python3.12 (supported)
  [✓]      Memory — 512 MB
  [✓]      Timeout — 15s
  [✓]      Environment variables — KMS-encrypted (alias/lambda-env-key)
  [✓]      VPC — Private subnets (subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb) + sg-orders-api + NAT Gateway
  [✓]      Destination — On-failure SQS (order-api-dlq)
  [✓]      Logging — /aws/lambda/order-api-prod, retention 30 days
  [✓]      Tracing — X-Ray Active mode
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lambda get-function-configuration --function-name order-api-prod
  aws lambda get-function-event-invoke-config --function-name order-api-prod
  aws logs describe-log-groups --log-group-name-prefix /aws/lambda/order-api-prod

eval_cases.name: Deprecated nodejs14.x runtime — deployment blocker
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a Lambda function named "legacy-processor" in us-east-1. Runtime: nodejs14.x. Handler: index.handler. Memory: 256 MB, Timeout: 10s. Execution role: legacy-processor-role. The zip package is at ./function.zip. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FUNCTION: legacy-processor
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗]      Runtime — nodejs14.x is DEPRECATED (blocked for deployment). Migrate to nodejs20.x or nodejs22.x.
  [✓]      Execution IAM role — legacy-processor-role
  [✓]      Memory — 256 MB
  [✓]      Timeout — 10s
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lambda get-function-configuration --function-name legacy-processor

eval_cases.name: VPC-attached function needing internet but no NAT Gateway
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — NAT Gateway required for internet access
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a Lambda function named "webhook-sender" in us-east-1. Runtime: nodejs20.x. Handler: index.handler. The function is attached to VPC subnets subnet-private-a, subnet-private-b (private subnets, no NAT Gateway configured). It needs to send HTTP POST to https://api.partner.com/webhook (external internet endpoint). Memory: 512 MB, Timeout: 10s. Execution role exists with AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FUNCTION: webhook-sender
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Runtime — nodejs20.x (supported)
  [✓]      VPC — Private subnets (subnet-private-a, subnet-private-b)
  [✗]      VPC — NAT Gateway REQUIRED for internet access (https://api.partner.com). Without NAT Gateway, the VPC-attached function cannot reach external endpoints.
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ec2 describe-nat-gateways --filter Name=subnet-id,Values=subnet-public

eval_cases.name: Java 21 Spring Boot with SnapStart + provisioned concurrency
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SnapStart + provisioned concurrency on alias
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a production Java Lambda function named "enterprise-api-prod" in us-east-1. Runtime: java21. Handler: com.example.ApiHandler::handleRequest. It is a Spring Boot API behind API Gateway with strict latency requirements (P99 < 200ms). Enable SnapStart to reduce cold starts. Provisioned concurrency: 20 on the "prod" alias. Memory: 2048 MB, Timeout: 30s. X-Ray tracing active. On-failure destination: enterprise-api-dlq (SQS). ECR image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/enterprise-api:latest. CloudWatch retention: 90 days. Execution role: enterprise-api-exec. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FUNCTION: enterprise-api-prod
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Execution IAM role — enterprise-api-exec
  [✓]      Runtime — java21 (supported, SnapStart eligible)
  [✓]      Memory — 2048 MB
  [✓]      Timeout — 30s
  [✓]      SnapStart — Enabled (ApplyOn=PublishedVersions)
  [✓]      Provisioned concurrency — 20 on alias "prod"
  [✓]      Packaging — ECR image (123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/enterprise-api:latest)
  [✓]      Destination — On-failure SQS (enterprise-api-dlq)
  [✓]      Logging — /aws/lambda/enterprise-api-prod, retention 90 days
  [✓]      Tracing — X-Ray Active mode
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lambda get-function-configuration --function-name enterprise-api-prod
  aws lambda get-function-configuration --function-name enterprise-api-prod --query 'SnapStart'
  aws lambda list-provisioned-concurrency-configs --function-name enterprise-api-prod

eval_cases.name: Report generator with all correct defaults (DynamoDB + S3 + layers)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — all checklist items verified, layers + Powertools
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a production Lambda function named "report-generator-prod" in us-east-1. Runtime: python3.12. Handler: generate.handler. The function reads from DynamoDB (table: reports-table) and writes PDF reports to S3 (bucket: reports-output-prod). Use the AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole managed policy plus scoped DynamoDB read + S3 write permissions. KMS key alias/lambda-env-key for env var encryption. Environment: REPORTS_TABLE=reports-table, OUTPUT_BUCKET=reports-output-prod. Memory: 1024 MB, Timeout: 60s. Layers: Powertools for Python v3 (python3.12-x86_64). On-failure destination: report-gen-dlq (SQS). X-Ray active. CloudWatch retention: 30 days. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=report-generator. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FUNCTION: report-generator-prod
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Execution IAM role — least-privilege (DynamoDB + S3 scoped)
  [✓]      Runtime — python3.12 (supported)
  [✓]      Memory — 1024 MB
  [✓]      Timeout — 60s
  [✓]      Environment variables — KMS-encrypted (alias/lambda-env-key)
  [✓]      Layers — Powertools for Python v3
  [✓]      Destination — On-failure SQS (report-gen-dlq)
  [✓]      Logging — /aws/lambda/report-generator-prod, retention 30 days
  [✓]      Tracing — X-Ray Active mode
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Workload=report-generator
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lambda get-function-configuration --function-name report-generator-prod
  aws lambda get-function-event-invoke-config --function-name report-generator-prod
  aws logs describe-log-groups --log-group-name-prefix /aws/lambda/report-generator-prod
